jobs.title: Supply Chain System Manager
jobs.description:
WHAT MATX IS BUILDING

MatX's mission is to make the world's best AI models run as efficiently as allowed by physics, bringing the world years ahead in AI quality and availability.

Your place here

We're looking for a technical Supply Chain System Manager to architect, deploy, and optimize our digital supply chain infrastructure. You will be responsible for setting up and managing ERP, PLM, procurement, and inventory software systems to ensure data integrity, automation, and operational scalability.

You will sit at the intersection of IT, Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain, and Finance, shaping how automated data pipelines and system integrations power real-time visibility across our global operations.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO HERE:

 - Lead the strategy, selection, implementation, and enhancement of ERP, PLM, and spend-management systems

 - Build seamless data integrations across PLM, ERP, WIP and warehouse management, supplier portal systems

 - Ensure high data fidelity and accuracy for master data elements including BOMs, part numbers, vendor master files, and lead times

 - Develop automated workflows and dashboard reporting metrics for executive visibility into inventory, procurement spend, and pipeline bottlenecks.

 - Partner with engineering to streamline Engineering Change Order (ECO) release flows between PLM and ERP systems

 - Provide system administration, user training, access controls, and ongoing troubleshooting support for internal teams

 


WHO YOU ARE:

 - 6+ years experience administering or implementing supply chain systems (ERP, PLM, MRP, or WMS) in a hardware technology setting

 - Demonstrated expertise with systems such as NetSuite, SAPOne, Arena, Propel, Coupa, or similar platforms

 - Strong business systems analysis skillset, with the ability to translate operational workflows into scalable technical requirements

 - Ability to build customized AI tool is highly desirable

 - Excellent communication and change-management skills to train non-technical users on system capabilities

 - Excited to build digital supply chain foundations from the ground up in a scaling startup environment



Compensation

The US base salary for this full-time position is determined based on a variety of factors including role, experience, location, job related skills, and relevant education and training. Career length is only a guideline for compensation.

 - Mid Career - $175,000 - $400,000 + equity

 - Senior Career - $250,000 - $600,000 + equity

 
 

What We Offer

 - Time off: 4 weeks PTO (accrued) + 12 company Holidays + up to 3 weeks remote work

 - Health: Company-subsidized Medical (Kaiser or Anthem) for employees & dependents, Guardian Dental and Vision insurances for employee & dependents, and life insurance (employee only), plus HSA and FSA offerings via Lively. 

 - Financial Security: Choose from Roth or pre-tax 401K (or both) with a 5% company contribution (even if you don't contribute), 100% company-paid life insurance (up to $300K), long-term disability and travel insurance.

 - Professional Development: $1500 per year Professional Development Budget 

 - Team Meals: MatX provides onsite team lunch & dinner Monday - Friday, with your choice of ordering via WeBox, Specialty’s or via our reimbursement system

 - Commute on Us: We pay 100% for your daily commute.  Commute via our company rideshare account, reimburse public transportation, or get a Fasttrak card (or all three)

 - MatX E[x]tras: $50/mo to use on the perk you value most

 - Cell & Internet Reimbursement: $35/mo for cellular and $40/mo for wifi

 - Remote Home Setup: Use our Amazon business account for up to $1000 in office setup purchases. 

 - Mental Wellbeing: 100% paid mental health benefit via SpringHealth and Guardian EAP.

 - Support to Parents: Up to 12 weeks paid parental leave regardless of path to parenthood, 10 weeks pregnancy disability leave, flexible return-to-work hours, and a $6K Family Fund to cover fertility, surrogacy, adoption, menopausal health, preservation, family counseling and more.

As part of our dedication to the diversity of our team and our focus on creating an inviting and inclusive work experience, MatX is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, genetic information or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.
---------

This position requires access to information that is subject to U.S. export controls. This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant's capacity to perform job functions in compliance with U.S. export control laws without obtaining a license from U.S. export control authorities.
--------

MatX does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or People team and any resumes submitted are deemed to be the property of MatX.

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
WHAT MATX IS BUILDING

MatX's mission is to make the world's best AI models run as efficiently as allowed by physics, bringing the world years ahead in AI quality and availability.

Your place here

We're looking for a strategic Sourcing Manager to manage sourcing strategy for datacenter rack development, integration, contract manufacturing strategy, and key vendor partnerships across critical hardware modules. You will build and execute supplier strategies that align with our NPI to production schedule, manage rack-level integration partners, ensure top quality, and secure favorable commercial terms.

In this role, you will partner closely with Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain, and Executive Leadership to identify technical requirements, risk and opportunities, transition key component categories from early development to volume supply.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO HERE:

 - Develop and execute global strategic sourcing strategies for rack and key hardware component categories

 - Lead commercial negotiations, supplier selections, RFXs, and pricing agreements to ensure best cost, quality, and supply security

 - Manage supplier relationship management (SRM) programs, conducting executive business reviews (EBRs) and supplier scorecards

 - Partner with Hardware Engineering to assess market capabilities, influence design for total cost of ownership, and mitigate single-source risks

 - Collaborate with Legal and Contract Management to draft, finalize and execute to commercial and engineering contracts

 - Drive total cost of ownership (TCO) reduction initiatives while supporting rapid hardware iteration schedules

 


WHO YOU ARE:

 - 7+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, global supply management, or procurement within high-tech, rack manufacturing, or advanced hardware industries

 - Proven track record of negotiating complex multi-million dollar contracts and securing favorable commercial terms with tier-1 suppliers

 - Strong technical aptitude with the ability to converse effectively with hardware architects and domain engineering leads

 - Deep familiarity with supply chain dynamics, risk management, and vendor cost structure analysis

 - Excellent negotiation, presentation, and strategic leadership capabilities.

 - Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment requiring end-to-end category ownership
